page.overview:
Who is Oars?

Oars the Continent-Puller, also known as the "Devil", was an infamous ancient giant. Around 500 years ago, he wreaked havoc on the seas by conquering countries and hauling away entire islands, which he used to create a "nation of villains". He eventually died in the Land of Ice.

After he died, his body was unearthed by the Thriller Bark Pirates and was subsequently revived by Gecko Moria as Zombie #900, a Special Zombie. As the member of Moria's army animated using the stolen shadow of Monkey D. Luffy, he was a major obstacle that the Straw Hat Pirates had to overcome during their adventure on Thriller Bark. He is the direct ancestor of Little Oars Jr.

Due to his actions, he is a major antagonist of the Thriller Bark Arc.

Oars is an extremely large, red-skinned, skull-faced zombie who is more than four times the size of an average giant; his sheer size caused Roronoa Zoro and Franky to mistake his body for a large wall upon encountering it up close. Oars has two large horns and long yellow hair that flows from his head to his back. His upper teeth are squared, while his lower teeth are pointed with long canines. He is missing his right eye, and his left arm has "SZ-900" tattooed on it, "SZ" representing "Special Zombie" and "900" being his zombie classification number.
